latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Fitness Video Editor.

- Automatically detects exercise transitions in workout videos and adds animated exercise name overlays.
- Inserts real-time rep counters synchronized to movement cadence.
- Identifies rest periods and either cuts or marks them with a countdown timer.
- Applies interval-matched background music from a library of copyright-free fitness tracks.
- Exports videos in formats optimized for YouTube, Instagram, and fitness app platforms.
